playstyle.identity: Udyr is a stance-swapping bruiser who charges through enemies with bear form. His reworked kit offers more versatility and teamfight impact.
playstyle.howToPlay: Abilities are stances you swap between; awakening them adds power. Q (Wilding Claw) empowers autos with lightning. W (Iron Mantle) shields and heals. E (Blazing Stampede) stuns on first hit per target. R (Wingborne Storm) creates a storm around you. Cycle stances for max DPS.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Udyr spikes early with ganks and at level 6 with R awakening. Trinity Force or tank works. He's strong early-mid running at enemies.

passive.name: Bridge Between
passive.summary: Cycle stances to awaken them for bonus effects.
passive.details: Udyr has 4 stances. Swapping builds Awakened stacks. At 2 stacks, the next stance is Awakened with bonus effects.

abilities.name: Wilding Claw
abilities.summary: Empowers attacks with lightning damage. Awakened: lightning strikes after attacks.
abilities.details: Udyr empowers his next two attacks with bonus damage. Awakened: Auto attacks call down lightning that bounces to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Iron Mantle
abilities.summary: Gain shield and heal on attacks. Awakened: massive shield and heal.
abilities.details: Udyr gains a shield and his next two attacks heal him. Awakened: Shield and healing are significantly increased.

abilities.name: Blazing Stampede
abilities.summary: Gain speed and stun the first enemy hit. Awakened: immune to CC briefly.
abilities.details: Udyr gains movement speed and his first attack on each enemy stuns them. Awakened: Become immune to crowd control briefly.

abilities.name: Wingborne Storm
abilities.summary: Create a storm that damages enemies around you. Awakened: massive storm.
abilities.details: Udyr creates a glacial storm around him that slows and damages enemies. Awakened: The storm is much larger and deals more damage.
